reviews.review_text:
TanjungBaraDiver
Hanoi, Vietnam1974 contributions
0
Great craft beers and other beverages
Oct 2024 • Couples
This is a good spot for after work dinner which is exactly what we were doing. It's all upstairs but there is a play area downstairs if you have the kids along. We didn't book but they managed to find us a table, book if you want one against the window but there's a balcony in front of it so you may be staring at the backs of the smokers. 

Our table was find, a little shaky on the floor for some reason (every time someone walked past) but after beer number three it wasn't a problem. I stuck with 1664s but the missus had a Bloody Mary (excellent) and a few Ginger Beers which she really liked. 

My smash burger was very good and the lamb sate/kebab was excellent. We finished with a lemon meringue pie. I'm not sure if it was supposed to be frozen but that's the way it was, and the pastry needed to be hammered through with a knife, but it was tasty all the same.

Staff are super attentive, the general vibe is good and we'll be giving another go one day. For what it's worth it seems to be connected to Hummingbird somehow because the menus look identical. 

A nice spot for beers and pub food and we'll be back.

Chilled brunch spot with friends
Jun 2024 • Friends
Came here for a spot of brunch with friends on a Sunday. We booked a table in advance as we were a large group. The staff were very organised and divided the table into different billing cards, which saved the hassle at the end of dividing up the bill. The downside of this approach was that the food came out at different times, and it felt a bit disjointed. I enjoyed a chicken pesto sandwich with thick cut fries, and they made my day by having malt vinegar to soak the chips in!! Everyone seemed happy with the food and service, and it was a nice pace to sit and chat with friends without feeling rushed.

Friendly staff and bonus points for malt vinegar with chips
Mar 2024 • Couples
First visit here last night for some dinner. First impressions from entering from the street to downstairs was not great, it certainly didn't scream welcoming. But when we were directed upstairs it was much more impressive, very cool decor with good vibes, shame they haven't put the same thought into downstairs.
The staff are plentiful and friendly if not a little slow or difficult to get attention of sometimes.
They had cherry belgo beer on tap which was a massive bonus. We ordered chicken wings as a starter and they bought 6 instead of the 12 we ordered but it turned out to be a good thing. My husbands lamb smash burger with mac and cheese side was pure stodge in the right way. I braved fish and chips, which js always a gamble so far away from the UK. The fish was tasty with a good batter ratio. The chips were fairly average and on the greasy side but all was forgiven when they brought over malt vinegar, this can transform any dish so made it soooo much more yummier!!

Perfection!
Mar 2024 • Solo
Ok, so let me tell you, I am a big ribs fan.
And coming from Australia I can polish off a full rack. 
So when I ordered a full rack and the server advised the half rack, I was skeptical. But that sizing was perfect !! A full rack would have been double the size I am used to.
You can pick your sauce for the ribs, and for a white guy… I like my spice. So when I opted for the hottest spice, the server kept giving me an out.. but I kept to my guns and oh boy…
It wasn’t the hottest, but it was as hot as you want it to be without the heat stopping the enjoyment. Bang on point !
The ribs fell off the bone and went down like a treat.
You get 2 options of sides and I went with Mac and cheese and chips. The chips and the lemongrass sauce was amazing!
The Mac and cheese was swimming in cheese! I can’t fault this place at all!
The cocktails and cider are also amazing!!
Definitely recommend!

Good food, century long waiting
Feb 2020 • Couples
The food, like others said, are amazing. The service, however, is not. My first dish, chargrilled chicken, their signature one, was served after 20 mins, thats below average. The second one, quesadillas, came in ‘only’ 50 minutes later or so after, thats more than an hour after my order, after at least 4 times I asked the waiting staff, thats beyond any level of sympathy, and I could see that not many of the customers ordered food, they came for beers mainly. I do not blame the waitresses, they are not responsible for this and they were very helpful, but the ones are to blame is the owner, manager and the kitchen, the process was really an issue and I have to write a review.
